## Definition of Done (AGENTS.md §2)

- [ ] Unit tests added; coverage ≥ 90 % overall and ≥ 98 % in critical areas
- [ ] E2E test added or updated for any main user flow
- [ ] Bug fix includes a regression test
- [ ] Format, lint, import order and type checks pass with no warnings (`scripts/check-all.sh`)
- [ ] No new dependency, or each one is justified and pinned to an exact version
- [ ] End-user docs updated in `docs/user/` (or N/A explained above)
- [ ] Code review (`/code-review` or equivalent) and simplification pass (`/simplify` or equivalent) done before pushing
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are signed off (DCO)
